recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a shirtless man with extensive torso tattoos, wearing a black beanie and sunglasses, smoking. The scene is set in a modern, dimly lit environment with a cool, desaturated color palette and visible film grain.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between warm skin tones and cool, blue-grey background
Dynamic smoke trails intersecting the static subject
Repetition of circular forms in jewelry, watch, and background bokeh
Centralized subject dominance against a blurred architectural backdrop
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the subject's torso

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupies approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's tattooed chest and the glowing tip of the cigarette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face/smoke, follows the arm down to the hands, then moves across the detailed chest tattoos.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, out-of-focus architectural elements in the upper corners and background.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (Smoke, highlights on jewelry, and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the highlights and deep blacks in the shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with varying weights or widths for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.
Offers a classic, authoritative urban feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man with a beard, beanie, and sunglasses, shirtless with detailed black-and-grey tattoos on his chest and arms. He is holding a cigarette with smoke rising. The background is a dark, out-of-focus modern interior with cool teal-grey lighting and heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, white, condensed sans-serif text block in the top right corner, framed by a thin white rectangular border, containing three lines of stacked text.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette desaturated and cool-toned?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the text placed in the top right corner in a condensed sans-serif?
Are the tattoos rendered in a realistic black-and-grey style?

mustRedesign: Specific faces in tattoos to avoid likeness issues
Any specific brand logos on the beanie or sunglasses
The exact wording of the advisory label
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the hands and torso
Ensure smoke trails look natural and not digitally stamped
Verify the text is legible but not distracting
Confirm the desaturated teal-grey mood is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Desaturated Teal Grade + Heavy Film Grain + Condensed Sans-Serif Overlay
